title: Valkey settings
description: Password, persistence mode, and the few server settings a Valkey instance exposes.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password of the default user. Every client needs it. A new value takes effect at the next start.

persistence.title: Persistence
persistence.description: What survives a stop. rdb: snapshots on disk now and then and on a normal stop; a crash loses the writes since the last snapshot. aof: every write is logged and synced about once a second. volatile: memory only; every stop, restart, or crash loses all data, and there is nothing to back up or restore. Set once when the instance is created.

maxMemoryMb.title: Max memory (MB)
maxMemoryMb.description: Most memory Valkey uses for data. 0 means no limit.

maxMemoryPolicy.title: Eviction policy
maxMemoryPolicy.description: What Valkey does when the memory limit is reached. noeviction refuses new writes; the others remove keys.

logLevel.title: Log level
logLevel.description: How much Valkey writes to the instance log.

notifyKeyspaceEvents.title: Keyspace notifications
notifyKeyspaceEvents.description: Which key events Valkey publishes, as Valkey flag letters, for example Ex for expired keys. Empty turns them off.
